verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents a single API for searching 100M+ products from 25,000+ brands. Agents can reach it with no key through the MCP server or via MPP payments with no signup, or with free self-service API keys and no OAuth or partnership. Community reports criticize result relevance but do not contradict the programmatic, self-service access. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the keyless/MPP flow, and evidence that cross-merchant search relevance is reliable given community reports of poor results.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can programmatically search products or services across merchants — keylessly or with self-service credentials, no private partnership required

citations.quote: Access 100 million+ products from 25,000+ brands through one API.
You can use it without writing any code, and without an API key.
Agents can pay via MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) — no API key or signup required.
No OAuth flow is required for the public product data API. API keys are free to create.
